**{{< var days.d4.question >}}**

Day 4 asks when a model's answer can be trusted. Calibration measures whether a model's probabilities mean what they say; Module 12 turns calibrated probabilities into act, ask or escalate decisions, and asks what changes when calibration itself is the training objective: TypeSafe names this RLCD but has not published the method, so the module keeps what TypeSafe has stated apart from third-party reports and from our own illustration. Module 13 grounds answers in retrieved sources and measures retrieval and answers separately.
